newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SHARES IN CZECH SKODA RISE ON U.S. ORDER.
newsitem.headline: SHARES IN CZECH SKODA RISE ON U.S. ORDER.

text.p: Shares in the Czech Republic's biggest engineering company Skoda Plzen a.s. surged on Tuesday after the company said it had won an order to supply trolley buses worth $170 million to the U.S. city of San Francisco.
Towards the end of continuous trading on the Prague Stock Exchange on Tuesday, Skoda shares had risen 39 crowns, 4.6 percent, to 885.
